source.note: 2026-09-09 用户确认：规范页与 Figma 呈现结构已被她本人多次核对一致；图标库规模过大（1 组件集/3 variants + 267 standalone），本轮不再逐项做 Figma 真值复核，走 local-contract（与 Chart 处理方式一致）。2026-09-10 ICO-004：数字后缀图标暂不补语义名与别名。

purpose: 表达操作、对象或状态的图形资源；图标类型决定交付方式。

behavior.interactive: Icon itself is not interactive; an action requires a semantic control, accessible name and state feedback.
behavior.color: General icons inherit currentColor; preserve Effect icon colors.

constraints: Do not use emoji, Unicode stand-ins, CSS drawings or unregistered names.
Use iconfont System entries for page selection; system-manifest is source-audit data, not a second library.
Use hyphens inside the icon-name segment; resolve a registered underscore alias to its canonical name before rendering, and never show the alias as a duplicate resource.
Do not rename the 20 numeric-suffix System icons or invent semantic aliases (ICO-004, 2026-09-10: 暂不补充).
confirmedDecisions: 2026-09-10 ICO-003：4 个旧源名统一为 icon-code-regular、icon-delete-back、icon-delete-back-fill、icon-attachment；旧下划线名只作兼容别名，清单展示与新调用必须使用规范名。
2026-09-10 ICO-004：20 个无语义数字后缀图标暂不补充可区分英文语义名和兼容别名；继续使用现有调用名。
